head_commit.message:
evidence(282): record the App PR-venue head-move race found on PR #305

The admission-check failure on PR #305 was not content-related:

  MINT_PUB_A0: FAIL - PR #305 head.sha '434d4ce9e5b4' != headSha input
  '2f2135b84832' (fail-closed)

Pushing a second commit left the first head's admission-gate run in flight.
mint-publish's A0 guard compares the live PR head against the run head and
fails closed, which is correct for that run. The Admission App then published
a verdict against the *current* head using the stale run, recording
reasons=run_head_mismatch | conclusion=failure - it detects the mismatch and
still attributes failure to the new head. A conclusion=null App check-run also
lingered on the previous head for over 25 minutes.

Recorded as discoveredDefects.APP-PR-VENUE-HEAD-MOVE-RACE. The App source is
outside this repository, so the fix is not in scope; the recovery is a single
push to a fresh head, which this PR uses.
